text:
alyssa: FYI support flagged a small set of tenants seeing duplicated lines in the invoice PREVIEW at ~03:12 UTC — final invoices look correct but console is confusing customers

sam: confirmed. ingest path emitted provisional metering events with epoch=null, then joiner emitted final events with epoch a few hundred ms later. preview pipeline currently shows both because dedupe is async. example log:
```
2026-03-22T03:12:01.120Z INFO ingest handler req_id=ri_22a epoch=null route=embed-heavy tokens=97 status=accepted
2026-03-22T03:12:01.372Z INFO joiner commit req_id=ri_22a epoch=ep-20260322-03 tokens=97 status=committed
```

mira: that pattern will create two preview rows until the canonical dedupe finishes. Support is getting noisy about "we see two charges" even though they won't be billed twice. Quick mitigation ideas?

jordan: short-term: console-side collapse of preview rows when we detect final commit within configurable window (5m default). Show collapsed row with a small "provisional" badge and an expand arrow for audit. Low-risk and reversible.

alyssa: sounds good. medium-term? want to fix root cause not just UI.

sam: two complementary infra fixes: (A) edge-proxy can optionally wait X ms for epoch assignment before emitting provisional events (per-route override). (B) introduce a shadow-preview stream + a lightweight dedupe store (Redis w/ Lua) that decides whether to surface provisional items to preview. Shadow lets us test behavior without changing user-visible path.

mira: UX: add a route toggle "Consistent invoice preview". Modal copy: "Enable a brief debounce for this route to reduce duplicate preview items. May add ~5-30ms median latency. Recommended for billing-sensitive routes." Also add an audit-only toggle so support can always view raw provisional lines.

sam: telemetry plan: add counters and histograms: meter.provisional_emitted, meter.provisional_wait_ms (p50/p95), meter.preview_duplicate_count, meter.dedupe_redis_errors. Tag by route and tenant. eng-telemetry-bot, please create a small playground dashboard for the canary.

eng-telemetry-bot: created dashboard metering/preview-duplicates (viewers: eng-platform,billing). Added panels: preview_duplicate_rate, provisional_wait_ms p50/p95, preview_duplicate_count by route.

jordan: implementation notes: dedupe key should be composite: primary (request_id), secondary (client_request_id if present), plus provisional_epoch||final_epoch. For streaming requests include stream_session_id. The Redis Lua should atomically upsert and return whether we've seen a final already. TTL of 48h. Partition by tenant namespace to reduce hot keys.

sam: SDK gap: many SDKs don't send client_request_id on retry. We should standardize x-client-request-id header across SDKs and add it to retry logic. SDK-team, can we add this to 3 SDKs this week?

sdk-team-bot: RFC posted: https://docs.internal.redwood/sdks/client-request-id-rfc. JS/Python Go SDK PRs planned for this sprint. Will coordinate backcompat and changelog.

mira: console visibility: when collapsed show an info tooltip "Provisional rows collapsed — final value will be used for billing" and a link to explain how preview works. Also surface a small telemetry sparkline in the modal so admins can see preview duplicate rate before toggling.

jordan: rollout plan: 1) console collapse (opt-in for support) ASAP. 2) shadow-preview + Redis dedupe behind flag; run 5% tenant canary for 72h. 3) edge per-route provisional_wait_ms feature flag for billing routes, start at 50ms for canary, measure p50 delta. 4) if metrics good, enable toggle in console for customers.

alyssa: owners: mira -> console collapse + modal + admin audit toggle. sam -> edge change + telemetry + coordinate SDK header rollout. jordan -> shadow-preview, Redis Lua dedupe, e2e tests. I'll coordinate canary windows and support comms. Ops: hold alerts for similar preview spikes during canary.

ops-bot: INC-4821 suppressed for affected tenant cohort during investigation. Ticket INC-4830 created to track canary and rollback hooks.

sam: one more corner: retries that generate a new request_id defeat dedupe. We'll treat client_request_id as the canonical id when present; edge will synthesize if SDK misses it but will add telemetry for synthesized ids.

jordan: tests: add e2e harness that reorders provisional/final emits and asserts preview dedupe. Also test streaming append cases where tokens accrue across frames. Dedupe key must include stream_session_id for that.

mira: UX follow-up: add small "why am I seeing this" help center doc and link it from the collapsed row. Also add an admin toggle to opt a tenant out of auto-collapse for auditing windows.

eng-telemetry-bot: recommended alerts: notify if preview_duplicate_rate > baseline by 3x for >10m; alert if dedupe_redis_errors > 1% of dedupe attempts.

alyssa: timeline: console quick fix today (mira), shadow + redis + e2e in 48-72h (jordan), edge feature-flag + SDK header handled in sprint by sam and SDK team, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~7 days if stable. ops to watch dashboards and abort if p50 latency increases >10% or support tickets don't drop.

sam: linking WIP PRs when available. I'll also add the telemetry counters as feature-flag gated so we can monitor without noise.

jordan: will add redis lua snippet and bench notes in PR, plus a foldable docs section describing dedupe semantics.

mira: will post modal mock and help center draft in thread when ready.

alyssa: thanks — let's reconvene 11:00 PT in #eng-platform after initial PRs are up. If you see another preview spike, drop sample log lines (request_id + tenant) here. :thumbsup:
